anomalies.description: A spherical explosive device detonates in mid-air just above the prone soldier, producing a visible fireball and shockwave; the explosion is captured at its initial burst phase.; A visible explosion occurs near the soldier on the ground, indicated by a rapidly expanding dust cloud and debris in frame f8 (35.5s) and immediate aftermath in f9 (36.0s).

A projectile (likely bullet or shrapnel) is visible in flight in frame f10 (37.0s), having been fired from off-screen left; preceding frame f9 (36.5s) shows motion blur consistent with rapid discharge or impact.

A weapon barrel is shown in close-up; at f1 (44.5s), a muzzle flash and smoke are visible, indicating a shot being fired. The subsequent frames (f2–f3) show the vehicle recoiling and dust kicked up, consistent with firing from a mounted weapon.

A building is struck by a projectile, initiating a progressive detonation: initial impact and dust cloud at f4 (46.0s); increasing structural damage and debris ejection through f5–f7; secondary blast with fire and fragmentation at f12 (50.0s); full destruction and debris dispersal through f15 (51.5s).
A large explosion occurs in a desert setting, with debris and dust violently ejected upward and outward; the blast wave and smoke plume expand progressively across frames f0–f6.
Close-up of a tank barrel with visible muzzle flash (glowing red interior) and emerging smoke, indicating a recent or ongoing shot fired at ~57.0–58.0s.
